firmware.title: USB Wi-Fi adapter 0.3.0
firmware.about: The S3 becomes the handheld's Wi-Fi card: plugged into the board's native USB port, it puts the handheld on the Wi-Fi it joins (its own address there, SSH and FireFly work), and you pick networks and type passwords on the Provisioner's S3 USB Wi-Fi page. Flash it through the board's UART (CH343) port.
firmware.licence: MIT; built on ESP-IDF, esp_tinyusb (Apache-2.0), TinyUSB (MIT), lwIP (BSD-3) (licenses/S3-USB-WiFi-NOTICE.txt)
